description:
Job Family : 
SAAS/PAAS/Cloud Application Development 
 Travel Required : 
Up to 10% 
 Clearance Required : 
Active Secret 
 
 What You Will Do : 
 We are seeking a Salesforce Engineer (Developer) who combines strong platform development expertise with a passion for delivering modern, scalable, and secure Salesforce solutions. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and helping clients unlock the full value of Salesforce technologies.
 While not required, experience with AI, Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Generative AI, or AI-assisted development tools is highly desirable as organizations continue to integrate intelligent automation into their digital ecosystems.
 Design, build, and maintain scalable Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, and platform-native automation.
 Develop integrations to connect Salesforce with enterprise systems.
 Translate business and functional requirements into clear technical designs and high-quality implementations.
 Build secure, performant data models and application architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices.
 Support full SDLC activities including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
 Troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, and performance layers.
 Collaborate closely with architects, product owners, analysts, and QA teams within an Agile delivery model.
 Contribute to code reviews, reusable frameworks, and continuous improvement of engineering standards.
 Stay current on emerging Salesforce capabilities including AI, automation, Experience Cloud, and platform releases.
 
 What You Will Need : 
 Bachelor’s degree is required.
 Minimum of FOUR (4) years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including Apex, LWC, Flows, and API integrations.
 Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, security, permission sets, sharing, and declarative configuration.
 Experience designing and building integrations using REST and SOAP API, and asynchronous processing including Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, Scheduled Jobs, and Event-Driven Architectures.
 Proficiency with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
 Experience with source-driven development: Salesforce DX, Git, pull requests, CI/CD pipelines, and structured release management.
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery practices.
 Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
 Experience with Experience Cloud
 An active federal security clearance (Secret or higher).
 
 What Would Be Nice To Have : 
 Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Administrator, or App Builder.
 Experience supporting public sector, federal, or large enterprise environments.
 Exposure to Data Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein, or AI-assisted development and automation tools.
 Prior work in Government Cloud or Government Cloud Plus environments.
 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $113,000.00-$188,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer: 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Parental Leave

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Group Term Life and Travel Assistance

 Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance

 Health Savings Account, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Transit and Parking Commuter Benefits

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development, Certifications & Learning Opportunities

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Care.com annual membership

 Employee Assistance Program

 Supplemental Benefits via Corestream (Critical Care, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Assistance and ID theft protection, etc.)

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus

 
 About Guidehouse 
 Guidehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer–Protected Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities or any other basis protected by law, ordinance, or regulation.
 
 Guidehouse will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable law or ordinance including the Fair Chance Ordinance of Los Angeles and San Francisco.
 
 If you have visited our website for information about employment opportunities, or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Guidehouse Recruiting at 1-571-633-1711 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@guidehouse.com . All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodation.
 
 All communication regarding recruitment for a Guidehouse position will be sent from Guidehouse email domains including @guidehouse.com or guidehouse@myworkday.com .  Correspondence received by an applicant from any other domain should be considered unauthorized and will not be honored by Guidehouse.  Note that Guidehouse will never charge a fee or require a money transfer at any stage of the recruitment process and does not collect fees from educational institutions for participation in a recruitment event. Never provide your banking information to a third party purporting to need that information to proceed in the hiring process.
 
 If any person or organization demands money related to a job opportunity with Guidehouse, please report the matter to Guidehouse’s Ethics Hotline. If you want to check the validity of correspondence you have received, please contact recruiting@guidehouse.com . Guidehouse is not responsible for losses incurred (monetary or otherwise) from an applicant’s dealings with unauthorized third parties.
 
 Guidehouse does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Guidehouse and Guidehouse will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.
